title: Additive operator-scoped Work proposal preview, unavailable until qualified
description: Separately advertised work.proposal.read.v1 through extension.query.invoke.v1. Not a mutation or an extension of frozen work.read.v1. Immutable host human actor + current operator/read grant required; no actor/class assertion in input. Total result including framing <=64KiB and <=128 records; snapshot/store/generation-bound ordinals, grant-filtered before paging.

request.description: proposal_id=null lists scoped pending proposals; exact ID returns at most one scoped proposal. Exact-ID requests require after_cursor=null. No disclosure of existence outside grant scope. Read does not refresh a proposal or authorize a later confirmation.

proposal.description: chosen_action is the immutable recorded proposal, not a rewritten current action. current_preconditions is diagnostic only. Confirmation sends exact proposal_id/input_revision/chosen_action and repeats human grant, hard policy and all revisions in the consequential CAS. Stale/changed choice is rejected, not silently rebased. Preview carries no claim/run/credential secrets.

result.description: Grant filtering and byte cap apply before returning records/cursor. Oversized single record fails locally, never truncates chosen_action. Unknown scoped ID returns empty proposals, not fabricated metadata; retired/stale domains fail locally, not authoritative absence. Empty result is not an operation receipt absence assurance.
